profile: Fixed synthetic, well-shimmed cardiac B0; not a measured field map from the supplied phantom
field_scaling: Frequency offsets scale by scanner field strength / 3 T, consistent with susceptibility offsets at fixed geometry and shim quality
sd_definition: Unweighted native occupied myocardial cell centres in the supplied cardiac central slice; this statistic describes the synthetic profile, not a clinical measurement

sources.use: Order-of-magnitude context for the fixed well-shimmed profile; does not prescribe a linear field shape

sources.population: 18 subjects at each field, midventricular LV after local second-order shim
sources.use: Clinical context and field-strength dependence; these maxima are not SDs, peak-to-peak ranges or the benchmark gradient. Localized susceptibility patterns can differ from the fixed linear profile
